caption:
🚨 Apple just rolled out a whole new Siri, and it might be the biggest iPhone update in years

For years Siri felt stuck while every other assistant got smarter. Siri AI is Apple's answer, and it's rolling out now in beta with iOS 27.

→ Point your Camera at anything and ask Siri about it
→ Keep asking follow-up questions, it remembers the context
→ Ask it to act inside apps like WhatsApp and Audible

Which one are you trying first: Visual Intelligence or the cross-app actions? 👇 Save this before you update to iOS 27.

slides.title: Siri finally got the AI brain transplant it needed
slides.sub: A whole new Siri is rolling out now in beta, with iOS 27.
slides.voiceover: Apple just rolled out Siri AI, a completely rebuilt Siri, in beta.

slides.label: What launched
slides.title: Siri AI, in beta
items: French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish in October
slides.voiceover: It launched in English on September 14th, with five more languages coming in October.

slides.label: 3 things to try today
slides.title: What's actually different
items: Point your Camera at something and ask Siri about it
Keep asking without repeating yourself — Siri holds the context
Ask it to act inside apps like WhatsApp and Audible
slides.voiceover: Three things to try: Visual Intelligence, follow-up questions, and actions inside other apps.

slides.label: Try it now
slides.title: Visual Intelligence, on iPhone
steps: Point it at whatever you want to ask about
It appears right in the camera view
"What is this?" or "add this event to my calendar"
Ask a follow-up — it remembers what you just asked
slides.voiceover: On iPhone, Visual Intelligence lives right inside the Camera app.

slides.label: It understands your screen
slides.title: Onscreen awareness
items: Ask it to find something on the page and add it to your calendar
It can look up something you mentioned earlier and act on it
iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro
slides.voiceover: Siri can now look at what's on your screen and take action for you.

slides.label: Not everywhere yet
slides.title: Before you get too excited
items: Not available in the European Union at launch
Not available in China, pending regulatory approval
English only for now — 5 more languages land in October
slides.cta: Check the Apple newsroom for your country's timeline.

slides.title: Siri AI is here.
lines: Visual Intelligence in your Camera app today
